# Shortsmith — pinned dependencies WITH hashes.
#
# Install with:
#     pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-lock.txt
#
# A version pin says which release to fetch. A hash says which BYTES are
# acceptable, so a re-uploaded or tampered artifact is refused rather than
# installed. Every wheel and sdist published for each pinned version is listed,
# because which one pip picks depends on your OS and Python build.
#
# requirements.txt is the readable list and stays in step with this file.
# Regenerate after changing a pin.
